title: Data Center MEP Senior Estimator (Nashville, TN)
description:
The Global Program Controls organization provides governance, reporting, controls processes, cost management support, and portfolio visibility to help Oracle Cloud Infrastructure deliver global data center programs with greater consistency, transparency, and execution discipline.


Oracle is seeking an experienced MEP Senior Estimator (IC4\) to support hyperscale data center development, colocation build\-outs, and infrastructure delivery across multiple regions. This is a senior, hands\-on individual\-contributor role with end\-to\-end responsibility for conceptual, budgetary, and detailed estimates across mechanical, electrical, plumbing, process, fire protection, controls, low\-voltage, and related mission\-critical systems.


The MEP Senior Estimator will serve as Oracle's owner\-side cost authority for assigned projects, translating design maturity, system capacity, market conditions, contractor pricing, and field execution realities into defensible budgets and decision support. The role will independently review and normalize estimates submitted by colocation providers, contractors, and quantity surveying partners; lead pricing reconciliation and negotiation; align estimates to approved cost breakdown structure (CBS) and work breakdown structure (WBS) requirements; and present clear cost recommendations to Finance and senior leadership.


**Estimating and Cost Model Development**

* Own the development, validation, reconciliation, and defense of conceptual, budgetary, and detailed MEP and process estimates for complex data center projects, programs, and strategic initiatives.
* Develop estimates with limited or evolving design information using capacity, topology, redundancy, equipment counts, quantities, labor productivity, regional market data, historical actuals, and parametric metrics such as cost per MW, rack, square foot, or system.

description:
Senior Power Project Manager \- (196062\)
At HDR, our employee\-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day.
